universe_note:
Chain-level campaign-v1 screen (identity_schema campaign-v1, scenario_id null), first run for this chain. Universe built per LINK across all 14 links, worked in priority order: the one money-corner link first, then the one CHOKE_POINT link, then the rest by chain position. The mapping (data/mappings/minor-nsr-permits.json, 15 issuers, 18 placements) is ACTIVE and carries no audit block at all (no fresh-context census audit has ever run on it), so every row this run rests entirely on Ron's 2026-09-01 PLACEMENT-scope rule: audit_scope 'PLACEMENT' declared on the row, admitted only when the consumed placement's role evidence is entirely VERIFIED. That mechanical bar turns out to be the whole story here: of the mapping's 18 placements, only 2 (both ONT, on air-permitting-and-dispersion-modeling and emissions-monitoring-and-compliance) carry all-VERIFIED evidence; the other 16, covering all 7 issuers this campaign has already profiled to COMPLETE (CATERPILLAR, CUMMINS, FUEL-TECH, CECO-ENVIRONMENTAL, TETRA-TECH, AECOM, JACOBS-SOLUTIONS), carry a single INFERRED-tagged role-evidence item apiece and are blocked by tools/check_screen.py's _placement_admissible regardless of profile status. ONT itself has no profile on disk. Net result: every one of this mapping's 18 placements is inadmissible this run, by one of the two independent gates (evidence tier, or profile completeness), and this screen seats zero rows across all 14 links. This is a structural finding about the mapping's evidence, not a search failure: nothing here was left unsearched.

emissions-aftertreatment-and-catalyst [MONEY CORNER, UNDISCOVERED, EXHAUSTED at 4/5]: searched and empty. The mapping's own link_coverage record closed this link EXHAUSTED with 4 public issuers established (Caterpillar, Cummins, Fuel Tech, CECO Environmental) via a 25-hit SEC EDGAR full-text search plus direct confirmation that the named private specialist (EcoCAT) is not public; a fifth known-public candidate, Johnson Matthey plc (LSE:JMAT, owner of Cormetech), could not be added for lack of a fetchable official UK securities source. All 4 counted issuers carry COMPLETE O2 profiles on disk (written this campaign) and would mechanically clear the profile-completeness half of admission. All 4 fail the other half: each placement's sole evidence item is tagged INFERRED (a Power Generation Enterprises compliance-guide citation for Caterpillar; comparable single-source citations for the other three), never VERIFIED. The chain's own money-corner link is therefore genuinely empty this run because of the evidence tier alone, not because of missing coverage or missing profiles. Promoting these 4 placements to VERIFIED needs a fresh-context placement audit (run universe-audit minor-nsr-permits --placement <issuer_id>, Atlas's lane) on each; that is the single highest-leverage next step for this chain, since it would unblock the money-corner link outright.

state-air-permitting-authority [CHOKE_POINT, UNDISCOVERED, EXHAUSTED at 0/5]: searched and empty by construction. The mapping's own link_coverage record closes this link EXHAUSTED with 0 issuers: state and local minor-source air permitting authority is a governmental function performed by environmental agencies (Virginia DEQ and its Air Pollution Control Board stand in as the representative state) under Clean Air Act State Implementation Plans, and no private company anywhere performs this role. Zero placements exist on this link in the mapping; there is nothing for a screen to seat or to block, and the chain's own bottleneck note independently confirms this is the true gate on the map precisely because it has no instrument.

federal-minor-nsr-rule [UNDISCOVERED, EXHAUSTED at 0/5]: searched and empty by construction, same reasoning as state-air-permitting-authority one position downstream: the rulemaking (Federal Register 2026-13667) is published and administered solely by the U.S. EPA, a federal agency with no listed equity. Zero placements.

air-permitting-and-dispersion-modeling [UNDISCOVERED, TARGET_MET at 5/5]: searched and empty. Five issuers are mapped (TETRA-TECH, AECOM, JACOBS-SOLUTIONS, ONT, ICF-INTERNATIONAL), all ACTIVE placements. TETRA-TECH, AECOM and JACOBS-SOLUTIONS each carry a COMPLETE O2 profile but a single INFERRED-tagged evidence item, blocked on evidence tier exactly as the money-corner link above. ONT carries all-VERIFIED evidence (SEC EDGAR company-submissions metadata, tag VERIFIED) but has no profile on disk anywhere in the repo; it is mechanically admissible on the mapping side and blocked only by profile completeness, so it is this chain's best near-term candidate for run profile --campaign. ICF-INTERNATIONAL is blocked on both counts (INFERRED evidence, no profile).

onsite-reciprocating-gensets [CROWDED, OPEN at 1/5]: searched and empty. Sole placement CATERPILLAR (COMPLETE O2 profile, INFERRED evidence) is blocked on evidence tier, the same defect as its emissions-aftertreatment-and-catalyst placement; this is a second, independently-evidenced placement for the same issuer and both need their own placement audit.

packaged-gas-turbines [CROWDED, OPEN at 1/5]: searched and empty. Sole placement BAKER-HUGHES (INFERRED evidence, no profile) is blocked on both counts.

fuel-cell-permit-avoidance [OVER_CROWDED, OPEN at 1/5]: searched and empty. Sole placement BLOOM-ENERGY (INFERRED evidence, no profile) is blocked on both counts.

gas-supply-and-interconnection [CROWDED, OPEN at 2/5]: searched and empty. Both placements, ENERGY-TRANSFER and WILLIAMS-COMPANIES (INFERRED evidence each, neither profiled), are blocked on both counts.

liquid-fuel-logistics-and-storage [QUIET, OPEN at 0/5]: searched and empty. The mapping's own link_coverage record shows one search on file (not a formal EXHAUSTED census) finding every firm actually performing this role privately held (Mansfield Energy, Sun Coast Resources, Foster Fuels, Ricochet Fuel); listed distributors (World Kinect, Sunoco LP, Global Partners) were considered and left uncounted because no fetched source places them in this specific role. Zero placements on this link.

power-equipment-shared [None verdict, OPEN at 0/5]: searched and empty by declared design. The chain's own bottleneck note and the mapping's link_coverage record both mark this a SHARED STAGE DECLARATION (campaign blocker BLK-04): it IS ai-infrastructure/power-equipment, the identical seven-ticker stage (ETN, GEV, POWL, HUBB, ENR.DE, SU.PA, HPS-A.TO), deliberately mirrored so the duplication is visible. No issuer is placed here; all seven are counted once, at ai-infrastructure/power-equipment, and must not be double-counted toward this theme.

emissions-monitoring-and-compliance [QUIET, OPEN at 1/5]: searched and empty. Sole placement ONT (all-VERIFIED evidence) is mechanically admissible on the mapping side, the same finding as its air-permitting-and-dispersion-modeling placement, and is blocked only by having no profile on disk.

bridge-power-rental-fleets [EMERGING, OPEN at 1/5]: searched and empty. Sole placement UNITED-RENTALS (INFERRED evidence, no profile) is blocked on both counts.

behind-the-meter-power-developers [EMERGING, OPEN at 1/5]: searched and empty. Sole placement WILLIAMS-COMPANIES (INFERRED evidence, no profile) is blocked on both counts; this is the issuer's second placement on this chain (also on gas-supply-and-interconnection) and would need a stated secondary_link_basis even once admissible.

data-center-developer-demand [OVER_CROWDED, OPEN at 1/5, anchor]: searched and empty. Sole placement ORACLE (INFERRED evidence, no profile) is blocked on both counts.

queries_run.query: mapping placement resolution: every (chain_id, link_id, issuer_id) in data/mappings/minor-nsr-permits.json carrying ACTIVE status, joined to its role-evidence tags
COMPLETE O1/O2 profiles under data/companies/ whose issuer_id matches a minor-nsr-permits placement
evidence-tag admissibility: placements whose role evidence is all VERIFIED (audit_scope PLACEMENT eligible per Ron 2026-09-01) versus INFERRED (blocked pending a fresh-context placement audit)

data_gaps: The single highest-leverage next step for this chain: run universe-audit minor-nsr-permits --placement <issuer_id> (Atlas) on CATERPILLAR, CUMMINS, FUEL-TECH and CECO-ENVIRONMENTAL (all on the money-corner link emissions-aftertreatment-and-catalyst, all COMPLETE O2 profiles already on disk, all blocked only by an INFERRED evidence tag) would unblock the chain's money corner outright on the next screen run.

The same fresh-context placement audit on TETRA-TECH, AECOM and JACOBS-SOLUTIONS (air-permitting-and-dispersion-modeling, all COMPLETE O2, all INFERRED evidence) and on CATERPILLAR's second placement (onsite-reciprocating-gensets) would clear 4 more already-profiled issuers.

ONT is mechanically admissible on both its placements (air-permitting-and-dispersion-modeling, emissions-monitoring-and-compliance; both all-VERIFIED evidence) and blocked only by having no profile on disk anywhere in the repo. run profile ONT is the single fastest way to seat a row on this chain without touching data/mappings/ at all.

8 issuers carry ACTIVE mapping placements but INFERRED evidence and no profile (admissible-but-unprofiled, and additionally blocked on evidence tier): packaged-gas-turbines: BAKER-HUGHES. fuel-cell-permit-avoidance: BLOOM-ENERGY. gas-supply-and-interconnection: ENERGY-TRANSFER, WILLIAMS-COMPANIES. bridge-power-rental-fleets: UNITED-RENTALS. behind-the-meter-power-developers: WILLIAMS-COMPANIES (second placement). data-center-developer-demand: ORACLE. air-permitting-and-dispersion-modeling: ICF-INTERNATIONAL. Both gates would need clearing for any of these to seat.

No PENDING_DATA request rows were queued this run: zero rows were admitted to score, so no price, fundamentals or EDGAR fetch was needed. The blockers above are stage prerequisites (a fresh-context placement audit; a profile run), not missing market or filing data.

changelog.change: First run screen minor-nsr-permits (chain-level, scenario_id null). Built the per-link universe across all 14 links under audit_scope PLACEMENT (mapping ACTIVE, no census audit block at all). Of 18 placements across 15 distinct issuers, only 2 (both ONT) carry all-VERIFIED role evidence; the other 16, including all 7 already-COMPLETE-O2-profiled issuers (CATERPILLAR x2, CUMMINS, FUEL-TECH, CECO-ENVIRONMENTAL, TETRA-TECH, AECOM, JACOBS-SOLUTIONS), carry a single INFERRED evidence tag each and are blocked by the PLACEMENT audit_scope rule regardless of profile status. ONT itself has no profile on disk. Result: zero rows seated across all 14 links, including the one money-corner link (emissions-aftertreatment-and-catalyst, EXHAUSTED at 4/5 issuers per the mapping's own census, all 4 blocked on evidence tier) and the one CHOKE_POINT link (state-air-permitting-authority, EXHAUSTED at 0/5 by construction, a governmental function with no possible public issuer). Documented every link's disposition in universe_note; named the evidence-tier and profile-completeness blockers per issuer in data_gaps, with the money-corner placement audits flagged as the single highest-leverage next step. No PENDING_DATA requests queued: no row reached scoring.
